site.sitedescription: The Sandy Run Creek peat core was recovered at a distance of 250 m from Sandy Run Creek at a point approximately 2 m above sea level. Surrounding vegetation: Ferns and mosses are common in the Sandy Run Creek floodplain. Cyrilla racemiflora and holly are also common. The overstory includes Liriodendron tulipifera, Magnolia virginiana, Quercus nigra, Persea barbonia, Acer rubrum, hickory, and Nyssa aquatica.
